Someone who loves an episode of Live with Lena but isn’t ready to book a call has nothing to join. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

Call is the only door

Script 1 · “Someone else says it”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You said it first. Ten minutes later, someone else says it, and suddenly it’s a great idea.”

Body

“After 25 years in Fortune 500, I can tell you it’s rarely about the idea. It’s about presence: how you enter the conversation, when you speak, and how you follow up. Those are skills, and they can be practised.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it in a free 60-minute live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, white shirt and tie as in your profile photo. On-screen text: “Presence is a skill.”

Script 2 · “25 years”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I spent 25 years inside Fortune 500. Here’s what I wish someone had told me at year 15.”

Body

“Your experience doesn’t speak for itself. You have to translate it into a story people remember and a presence people trust. Most leaders never get taught how. That’s what my work is about.”

CTA

“Join my free masterclass, The Bold Chapter. Live, 60 minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to text “Experience → presence → influence.”

Script 3 · “Four doors”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’re an experienced leader, your next chapter usually has four doors.”

Body

“A bigger role. A board seat. Fractional work. Or your own business. Most people stand in the hallway for years because nobody helps them choose. In 60 minutes I’ll show you how to weigh each one.”

CTA

“It’s free and it’s live. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, four doors drawn on screen as you list them.
